units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 30:13">Targ. Y. Ex. XXX, 13</cite>.—Y. Keth. VII, 31ᵈ top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 2:4:5">Y. Kidd. II, 62ᵈ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00489"><he>גּוֹרְדִּינוֹן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 52b:12">Ab. Zar. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ טריינא והדריינא שיפא</he> Ms. (ed. <he>הדר׳ טוריי׳</he>) a Trojanic, Hadrianic denar which is rubbed off (i.e. Jewish coins restamped by Trojanus &c.).

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 6b:6">Ib. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ קיסראנא</he> (some ed. <cite ref="S01091"><he>קיסרנאה</he></cite>, Rashi <he>קס׳</he>) a Cæsarean denar (Ms. M. <he>ד׳ דקיסר</he> a denar coined in commemoration of coronation; cmp., however, <cite ref="D00657"><he>דִּיסְקוֹס</he></cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>דִּינְרִין</he>, <he>דִּינְרֵי</he>.
